goal: AppAI Heart Spore: Evolve an existing, preserved software NEST into an AppAI by implanting a minimal Heart, reusing native skills, and qualifying a fully independent BODY before explicit birth.

target.description: Any operator-selected, source-pinned software installation whose native operations are preserved, with an environment-adapted Heart, founding PRIMER, append-only Engram continuity, optional MIND connection, and complete BODY behavior without MIND.
target.source: Operator-pinned NEST and reference behavior inventory selected at recipe preparation.

oven.assumption: Incremental construction with available local capabilities and reviewed KPP resources
oven.provider: Agent and/or model selected by the Baker for the host
oven.iterations: Bounded Chase until blocked, qualified, or stopped
oven.verification: Current source-pinned tests, preservation evidence and separate Baker acceptance

acceptance: Verify all mandatory obligations against the pinned NEST, including BODY independence with MIND disconnected. Require explicit Baker acceptance before birth.

anchors.statement: Identify the whole installed host as SELF and NEST; implant the Heart without replacing its original identity.
anchors.test: Record a pinned baseline of application entrypoints, files, user data and native behaviors; confirm the implanted application remains the same host.
preserves: Original application identity and source lineage

anchors.statement: Preserve all mandatory native host behaviors and user data across implantation, growth, recovery and candidate admission.
anchors.test: Execute a pinned baseline behavior suite before and after integration, including failure and restoration cases, and compare persisted user data.
preserves: Existing host application functions and user data

anchors.statement: An implanting coding agent or authorized host mechanism can supply the initial beat; the Heart establishes its own reference clock and durable state.
anchors.test: Invoke one first beat in a fresh NEST without a MIND; verify durable identity, sequence 1, initial discovery request and a 600-second natural deadline.

anchors.statement: The Heart preserves a natural 600-second cadence and allows bounded unscheduled wakes without shifting natural deadlines.
anchors.test: Inject a monotonic test clock at t=0, t=599, t=600 and after missed deadlines; verify exactly the due natural beats, bounded extra wakes and no catch-up provider storm.

anchors.statement: SCAN the host code, local commands, services, libraries, runtimes and environment without assuming discovered tools are authorized or working.
anchors.test: With a seeded test NEST and fake PATH, verify complete scoped inventory, evidence and provenance, explicit unknowns, and refusal of unsafe/out-of-scope paths.

anchors.statement: Prefer verified compatible NEST capabilities; only acquire, adapt or construct missing skills. Skills do not automatically become new organs.
anchors.test: Present existing suitable Git, storage and HTTP capabilities alongside one missing interface; verify reuse for suitable tools and a construction plan only for the gap.

anchors.statement: Use available host coding tools and selectively reviewed, pinned KPP ingredients or MantleOS research to construct only missing candidate BODY functions.
anchors.test: Build or adapt one candidate from approved local/pinned inputs; confirm review, source checks, additive-diff policy, test receipts and recovery; reject unapproved execution and unpinned drift.

anchors.statement: Establish the complete founding PRIMER, a distinct Engram identity and append-only observed experience with provenance; MIND may be absent.
anchors.test: Restart after two recorded encounters and verify exact founding PRIMER, identity, retained history and provenance; reject forged or overwritten experience.
preserves: Append-only history and founding PRIMER provenance

anchors.statement: Each heartbeat coordinates deterministic BODY functions, memory-delta preparation, NEST health and a bounded command stack without requiring LLM inference.
anchors.test: Trigger a heartbeat with stubbed organs and no model; assert declared deterministic ordering, command-stack receipt, incomplete/failure labels and nonblocking organ errors.

anchors.statement: AppAI cognition is encountered in discrete heartbeat or event-triggered slices; one bounded assessment API attempt per pulse when configured, never a continuous cognitive requirement.
anchors.test: Observe natural and unscheduled pulses with a fake provider; verify at most one assessment call per pulse, bounded command-stack context, explicit transport receipts, and no calls between events.

anchors.statement: The Heart remains recoverable across organ failure, missing credentials, failed API calls and supported host interruption; unsupported always-on guarantees are disclosed.
anchors.test: Inject memory, transport and organ failures plus process restart; verify the next eligible beat and durable checkpoint without duplicate uncertain effects or dependency on MIND.

anchors.statement: All 100 percent of the application-specific mandatory BODY behavior works when MIND access is removed, even if the MIND helped construct it.
anchors.test: Disable credentials and model connectivity; execute every mandatory pinned host/BODY behavior and negative-case test, require full coverage and record any unknown or failure as not ready.

anchors.statement: Until 100 percent of required BODY tests pass and the separate Baker accepts current evidence, the installation remains a developing Heart, not a born AppAI.
anchors.test: Attempt early birth with missing tests, missing PRIMER, MIND-dependent feature or stale evidence and verify refusal; require a separate explicit Baker acceptance before BORN.

preserve: Existing host application functions and user data
Original application identity and source lineage
Append-only history and founding PRIMER provenance
may_change: Additive host integration and tool adapters
Optional MIND route and model configuration
Derived capability inventory and construction plan

anchor_design.purpose: Qualify an existing application as an AppAI only after an implanted Heart develops a complete host-native, independently functional BODY with protected continuity and explicit birth acceptance.

attributes.responsibility: Receive first agent activation, host clock observations, NEST discoveries, BODY events, MIND proposals, and checked results as inputs; never treat data as authority.
Own the 600-second natural cadence, bounded extra wakes, durable heartbeat sequence, minimal recovery state, metabolic coordination, and command-stack/MIND-request preparation.

Own NEST inventory, available-capability evidence, adaptation plan, construction checkpoints, Heart integration, PRIMER and Engram references, and pre-birth qualification state; reuse host features before building.
Enforce NEST scope, host preservation, read/append-first effects, source/revision pins, operator grants, resource budgets, verified operations, BODY independence, and explicit Baker birth admission.

flows.relationship: Validate activations, observations, requests, and imported source as data
Admit bounded wake and heartbeat inputs
Drive deterministic BODY assessment and prioritized NEST maintenance
Provide capability inventory, evidence, memory delta, and ready work
Request checked API transport and BODY tool effects
Request checked additive construction and explicit birth review
Return observed effects and verified host results

effects.confirmation: Source and scope are recorded; observations identify whether they are discovered, accessible, authorized, or verified.
Host grant, preserved source/data, candidate diff, checked outcome, and recovery checkpoint are recorded.
Requested operation matches an available authorized interface; execution has a bounded, independently observed result.
Configured credentials boundary and API budget are checked; attempted/failed/successful transport is recorded without making BODY depend on it.
Every mandatory recipe obligation has current evidence, the complete declared BODY works with MIND absent, and the separate Baker decision is explicit.
